framework: DPDP Act 2023 Sec 8(7) Storage Limitation & Statutory Retention Rules

rules.statutoryReference: DPDP Act 2023 Sec 8(7) (Storage Limitation) & IT Rules 2021
rules.deletionTrigger: User sign-out, session timeout, or 30 days of client inactivity
rules.auditRequirements: Session termination logged with anonymized client IP and timestamp

rules.deletionTrigger: Data Principal submits account erasure request
rules.auditRequirements: Erasure certificate generated and cryptographic hash recorded in audit log

rules.statutoryReference: DPDP Act 2023 Sec 8(7) & IT Rules 2021 Rule 3(1)(h)
rules.deletionTrigger: 90 days post review decision (approved/rejected) or account deletion
rules.auditRequirements: Binary file unlinked from S3; cryptographic erasure logged

rules.statutoryReference: TRAI TCCCPR 2018 Regulation 18 & DOT Call Detail Record mandates
rules.auditRequirements: Automated retention job purges audio files and recipient phone logs

rules.statutoryReference: Commercial contract dispute window & Limitation Act 1963
rules.auditRequirements: Aggregated monthly billing summary retained; granular hourly rows archived

rules.statutoryReference: Companies Act 2013 Sec 128 & Income Tax Act 1961 Sec 44AA
rules.deletionTrigger: 7 years from end of relevant financial assessment year
rules.auditRequirements: Zero ad-hoc deletion permitted; requires formal statutory board sign-off

rules.statutoryReference: Representation of the People Act 1950/1951, Delimitation Act 2002 & ECI Regulations
rules.deletionTrigger: NEVER (Statutory public records exempt from citizen erasure)
rules.auditRequirements: Cryptographic batch provenance anchors and version snapshots preserved
